Wael Bousmael · Architect

Luxury villa design for families in Jeddah

When the extended family comes for dinner, should the dining room open to the majlis and terrace, or should the courtyard stay private? Your first conversation with architect Wael Bousmael starts with your plot and the way you host. The call and preliminary concept are free. Once the direction suits you, we agree on the drawings and fee.

Request a free call WhatsApp

Breakfast in the kitchen, dinner with guests

In the Montashiri Villa design in Obhur, four stools run along the kitchen island. From a seat at breakfast you can see planting beyond the glazed door. To plan a larger dinner in your own home, we draw the table with every seat occupied and trace how the dishes reach it. That helps you decide which door to leave open to guests and where to keep preparation out of view.

Explore the kitchen and family living room at Montashiri Villa

Arriving for an evening on the terrace

In the Khamis Mushait Villa proposal, a curved stair leads from the terrace to a balcony beneath a timber-lined canopy. The night study picks out the planter and roof edge with light. For your own entrance, we consider the view from the gate and then from a seat indoors to decide what a guest sees on arrival and what the family sees from the house.

Frequently asked questions about private villa design

Can the villa commission include interior detailing?

Yes. Tell us which rooms you want to develop in detail, such as the majlis, kitchen or principal suite. Before you commission the work, the proposal sets out which furniture layouts, material choices and detail drawings are included and where specialist coordination is needed.

What should we bring if our plot is elsewhere in Saudi Arabia?

Start with the city and approximate plot area if you know it. A sketch showing the street edge or photos of a view you want to keep can be reviewed together on a video call. We can then discuss whether a site visit would help and how to arrange it.

How do we set a budget for design and finishes?

On the first call we discuss your allowance for construction and finishes and the rooms you want to prioritise. After you review the free concept, the proposal identifies the design fee and its drawings so you can budget separately for the contractor and suppliers.

May we measure how this site is used?

What gets counted?
